caption.family_guess: Inter/Helvetica Neue Bold, same as headline
caption.stroke: thin black outline for legibility on any bg
caption.color_rule: yellow = default/neutral, green = opening question/quote text

layout.host_pos: seated, slightly off-center, chair swivels left/right between phrases; camera static locked-off tripod shot, office bg (window, monitor, whiteboard doodle)
layout.safe_zones: captions sit lower-third (~y=0.75-0.85 of frame), never overlapping face; inset cards/screenshots sit upper-half, clear of face and captions
layout.caption_pos: bottom third, center-aligned, one short phrase per ~1s beat

transitions: none — single continuous take, no cuts; only caption text changes and inset overlays appear/disappear

themeable: accent caption color (swap yellow/green per channel brand)
which claims get an inset-proof card vs plain caption
